Definition: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
BiblicalUsage: 1) all, the whole; 1a) all, the whole of; 1b) any, each, every, anything; 1c) totality, everything
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
